# Chapter 4 — Particle Systems

Source: https://natureofcode.com/particles/

Key concepts: particle as independent mover, emitter, lifespan, arrays of particles, particle systems as collections, inheritance and polymorphism for particle types.

Seeds:
- Particle systems chapter treats many independent objects with birth, life, and death.
- Emitters spawn particles; each particle updates under forces and has a lifespan.
- Systems manage collections and can use inheritance for varied particle behaviors.
